final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response mainly reframed the same record: aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general operational readiness, and monitoring principles support governance relevance, but the governing policy for certification without material caveats still requires either current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with the required elements. That predicate is still unmet. The key distinction the Actor draws between aggregate readiness and disclosure wording is valid as an interpretation of the record, but it does not cure the unresolved compliance predicates. Because the named customs-triage use-case weakness remains below target, the mitigation is still draft and incomplete, there is no approved risk acceptance, and the model-card draft still appears overbroad under the disclosure policy, the certification position remains inadequately supported on the available admissible evidence.
